description: 桌面理线夹，带粘贴底座，卡 3 根线
description_en: Desk cable clip with adhesive base, holds 3 cables
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
base_w = 40      # 底座宽 (mm)
base_d = 15      # 底座深 (mm)
base_t = 3       # 底座厚 (mm)
slot_w = 5       # 卡线槽宽 (mm)
slot_h = 10      # 卡线槽高 (mm)
n_slots = 3      # 卡线槽数量
wall = 2         # 槽壁厚 (mm)

# === 底座 ===
result = cq.Workplane("XY").box(base_w, base_d, base_t, centered=(True, True, False))

# === 卡线槽 (一排开口向上的 U 形) ===
pitch = (slot_w + wall)
start_x = -((n_slots - 1) * pitch) / 2
for i in range(n_slots):
    x = start_x + i * pitch
    tooth = cq.Workplane("XY").box(slot_w + 2*wall, base_d, base_t + slot_h, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((x, 0, 0))
    slot = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=base_t).box(slot_w, base_d + 2, slot_h + 1, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((x, 0, 0))
    result = result.union(tooth).cut(slot)

result = result.edges("|Y").fillet(1)

show_object(result)
